function.name: observe
function.description: Get a new camera observation; no movement.

function.name: track_point
function.description: Select a static visible point in the latest RGB image. Pixels use origin top-left, u right, v down. Depth gives geometry at the selected pixel, not semantic object identity. Valid tracked points update automatically after motion; lost points have null current geometry. Select a reliable visible feature, not empty background.

function.name: get_geometry
function.description: Read current tracked points. Invalid points have no current metric position; reselect if needed.

function.name: move_relative
function.description: Command a displacement in the base horizontal frame at action start: forward positive, left positive, metres; length at most 0.6 m. The command is a target, not measured travel. Settling starts within 0.06 m of the target; final acceptance tolerance is 0.10 m, so a very small command can succeed with almost no motion. Use result.measured.translation_start_frame_m and observation.local_odometry to measure progress; do not sum requested distances. No path planning or obstacle avoidance.

function.name: turn
function.description: Relative yaw in radians, positive left. Absolute angle at most 0.6 rad.

function.name: stop
function.description: Set locomotion commands to zero and let the controller settle.

function.name: finish
function.description: Declare the task finished only after verifying the task and public completion_requirements using current geometry and measured body progress. The camera image alone does not prove that the base has crossed or cleared a passage. Independent evaluation decides success.

function.name: abort
function.description: Stop the episode without claiming success.
